```go
// queuedFile is a movie MediaFile importarr created over a stand-in file,
// before any probe.
type queuedFile struct {
	c    client.Client
	key  types.NamespacedName
	path string
}

func newQueuedFile(t *testing.T, ns string) queuedFile {
	t.Helper()
	c, _ := startEnv(t)
	ctx := t.Context()
	mustNamespace(t, ctx, c, ns)
	mustQualityProfile(t, ctx, c, "qp-video")
	mustMovie(t, ctx, c, ns, "inception", "qp-video")
	path := writeFile(t, t.TempDir(), "Inception (2010).mkv", []byte("stand-in bytes"))
	stat, err := os.Stat(path)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	const name = "inception-abc1234567"
	importarrCreatesMediaFile(t, ctx, c, ns, name, path, stat.Size(), stat.ModTime(), webdl720)
	return queuedFile{c: c, key: types.NamespacedName{Namespace: ns, Name: name}, path: path}
}

func (f queuedFile) get(t *testing.T) catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile {
	t.Helper()
	var mf catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
	require.NoError(t, f.c.Get(t.Context(), f.key, &mf))
	return mf
}

func (f queuedFile) uid(t *testing.T) string { return string(f.get(t).UID) }

func reconcileOnce(t *testing.T, r *mediafile.Reconciler, key types.NamespacedName) ctrl.Result {
	t.Helper()
	res, err := r.Reconcile(t.Context(), ctrl.Request{NamespacedName: key})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	return res
}

func reasonOf(mf catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile, typ string) string {
	if c := k8s.FindCondition(mf.Status.Conditions, typ); c != nil {
		return c.Reason
	}
	return ""
}

// A record for other bytes -- another UID, path or hash, or a probe below the
// wanted version answering a request below it -- is never incorporated: a
// probe of these bytes is requested instead.
func TestAStaleProbeRecordIsNeverIncorporated(t *testing.T) {
	f := newQueuedFile(t, "probe-stale-record")
	h := newProbeHarness(t)
	r := h.reconciler(f.c)
	uid := f.uid(t)
	info, err := os.Stat(f.path)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	hash := mediainfo.ProbeHash(f.path, info.Size(), info.ModTime())
	good := schema.ProbeRecord{
		MediaFile: schema.Ref{Namespace: f.key.Namespace, Name: f.key.Name, UID: uid}, Seq: 1,
		State: schema.ProbeProbed, Path: f.path, ProbeHash: hash, ProbeVersion: mediainfo.ProbeVersion,
		RequestedVersion: mediainfo.ProbeVersion, ProbedAt: time.Now().UTC(), MediaInfo: &commonv1.MediaInfo{VideoCodec: "hevc"},
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name   string
		mutate func(*schema.ProbeRecord)
	}{
		{"another MediaFile's UID", func(r *schema.ProbeRecord) { r.MediaFile.UID = "someone-else" }},
		{"another path", func(r *schema.ProbeRecord) { r.Path = f.path + ".old" }},
		{"other bytes", func(r *schema.ProbeRecord) { r.ProbeHash = "an-older-stat" }},
		{"an older probe answering an older request", func(r *schema.ProbeRecord) {
			r.ProbeVersion, r.RequestedVersion = mediainfo.ProbeVersion-1, mediainfo.ProbeVersion-1
		}},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			rec := good
			tc.mutate(&rec)
			h.putRecord(t, uid, rec)
			before := len(h.sent())
			reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
			got := f.get(t)
			assert.Nil(t, got.Status.MediaInfo, "a record for other bytes must never be incorporated")
			assert.Empty(t, got.Status.ProbeHash)
			assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileReasonProbePending, reasonOf(got, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileConditionProbed))
			assert.Len(t, h.sent(), before+1, "a probe of these bytes is requested instead")
			cur := h.record(t, uid)
			assert.Equal(t, schema.ProbeRequested, cur.Record.State)
			assert.Equal(t, hash, cur.Record.ProbeHash)
			assert.Equal(t, f.path, cur.Record.Path)
		})
	}
}

// A pending probe re-sends every status field catalogarr owns, on an object
// already in its steady state: a version-only request changes nothing at all;
// a probe of changed bytes reads ProbePending and releases nothing.
func TestAPendingProbeKeepsEveryOtherStatusField(t *testing.T) {
	f := newQueuedFile(t, "probe-pending-keeps")
	ctx := t.Context()
	h := newProbeHarness(t)
	r := h.reconciler(f.c)
	uid := f.uid(t)

	sr := &subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest{
		ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: f.key.Name, Namespace: f.key.Namespace},
		Spec:       subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequestSpec{MediaFileRef: f.key.Name},
	}
	require.NoError(t, f.c.Create(ctx, sr))
	_, err := k8s.PatchStatus(ctx, f.c, k8s.ManagerCaptionarrWorker,
		subtitleac.SubtitleRequest(sr.Name, sr.Namespace).WithStatus(subtitleac.SubtitleRequestStatus().WithItems(
			subtitleac.SubtitleItem().WithLangKey("en").WithState(subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleItemDownloaded).WithPath("Inception (2010).en.srt"))))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
	h.answer(t, uid, fakeMediaInfo())
	reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
	steady := f.get(t)
	require.NotEmpty(t, steady.Status.ProbeHash, "setup: never probed")
	require.Len(t, steady.Status.Sidecars, 1, "setup: no sidecar")
	steadyOwned := managedFieldPaths(steady.ManagedFields, "catalogarr", "status")
	steadyManagers := fieldManagerNames(steady.ManagedFields)

	assertKept := func(t *testing.T, got catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) {
		t.Helper()
		assert.Equal(t, steady.Status.ProbeHash, got.Status.ProbeHash)
		assert.Equal(t, steady.Status.ProbedAt, got.Status.ProbedAt)
		assert.Equal(t, steady.Status.ProbeVersion, got.Status.ProbeVersion)
		assert.Equal(t, steady.Status.MediaInfo, got.Status.MediaInfo)
		assert.Equal(t, steady.Status.Sidecars, got.Status.Sidecars)
		assert.Equal(t, steady.Status.Transcode, got.Status.Transcode)
		assert.ElementsMatch(t, steadyManagers, fieldManagerNames(got.ManagedFields), "no new field manager")
	}

	t.Run("a version-only re-probe changes nothing", func(t *testing.T) {
		mediafile.SetProbeVersion(t, mediainfo.ProbeVersion+1)
		res := reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
		got := f.get(t)
		assertKept(t, got)
		assert.Equal(t, steady.Status.Conditions, got.Status.Conditions)
		assert.Equal(t, steady.Status.Naming, got.Status.Naming)
		assert.Equal(t, steadyOwned, managedFieldPaths(got.ManagedFields, "catalogarr", "status"))
		sent := h.sent()
		require.NotEmpty(t, sent)
		assert.Contains(t, sent[len(sent)-1].Subject, ".low.", "a version-only re-probe takes the low lane")
		assert.Positive(t, res.RequeueAfter)
		assert.True(t, got.ProbeCurrent())
	})

	t.Run("changed bytes read ProbePending and release nothing", func(t *testing.T) {
		require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(f.path, []byte("re-encoded by hand, longer than before"), 0o644))
		later := time.Now().Add(2 * time.Second)
		require.NoError(t, os.Chtimes(f.path, later, later))
		reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
		got := f.get(t)
		assertKept(t, got)
		for _, typ := range []string{catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileConditionProbed, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileConditionReady} {
			c := k8s.FindCondition(got.Status.Conditions, typ)
			require.NotNil(t, c, typ)
			assert.Equal(t, metav1.ConditionFalse, c.Status, typ)
			assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileReasonProbePending, c.Reason, typ)
			assert.Contains(t, c.Message, "probe requested", typ)
		}
		require.NotNil(t, got.Status.Naming)
		assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.NamingReasonProbePending, got.Status.Naming.Reason)
		status, _ := managedFieldPaths(got.ManagedFields, "catalogarr", "status")["f:status"].(map[string]any)
		for _, leaf := range []string{"f:probeHash", "f:probedAt", "f:probeVersion", "f:mediaInfo", "f:sidecars"} {
			assert.Contains(t, status, leaf, "catalogarr released %s while the probe was pending", leaf)
		}
		assert.False(t, got.ProbeCurrent())
		assert.Contains(t, h.sent()[len(h.sent())-1].Subject, ".high.")
	})
}

// A transcode swap is incorporated only from a record for the swap target's
// path and new bytes; until then nothing is taken over.
func TestASwapIsIncorporatedOnlyFromARecordForItsTarget(t *testing.T) {
	f := newQueuedFile(t, "probe-swap-target")
	ctx := t.Context()
	h := newProbeHarness(t)
	r := h.reconciler(f.c)
	uid := f.uid(t)
	reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
	h.answer(t, uid, fakeMediaInfo())
	reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
	steady := f.get(t)
	require.NotEmpty(t, steady.Status.ProbeHash)

	// squasharr changed the container: the encode is an .mp4, the source retired.
	target := strings.TrimSuffix(f.path, ".mkv") + ".mp4"
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(target, []byte("the hevc encode, in mp4"), 0o644))
	require.NoError(t, os.Remove(f.path))
	mustTranscodeProfile(t, ctx, f.c, "hevc-main10", "profile-hash-def")
	tj := &transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob{
		ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: f.key.Name + "-abcd1234", Namespace: f.key.Namespace},
		Spec: transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobSpec{MediaFileRef: f.key.Name, ProfileRef: "hevc-main10",
			SourcePath: f.path, SourceProbeHash: steady.Status.ProbeHash},
	}
	require.NoError(t, f.c.Create(ctx, tj))
	_, err := k8s.PatchStatus(ctx, f.c, k8s.ManagerSquasharr, transcodeac.TranscodeJob(tj.Name, tj.Namespace).WithStatus(
		transcodeac.TranscodeJobStatus().WithPhase(transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobPhaseSucceeded).
			WithFinishedAt(metav1.NewTime(time.Now().Add(time.Second))).
			WithResult(transcodeac.Result().WithOutputPath(target).WithOutputSizeBytes(23))))
	require.NoError(t, err)

	reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
	got := f.get(t)
	assert.Equal(t, f.path, got.Spec.Path, "nothing is taken over before the target's probe lands")
	assert.Equal(t, steady.Status.Transcode, got.Status.Transcode)
	assert.False(t, got.ProbeCurrent())
	cur := h.record(t, uid)
	require.Equal(t, schema.ProbeRequested, cur.Record.State)
	assert.Equal(t, target, cur.Record.Path, "the request is for the swap target")
	assert.Equal(t, "high", cur.Record.Lane)

	// A record for the old path (a late answer from before the swap) is never incorporated.
	h.putRecord(t, uid, schema.ProbeRecord{
		MediaFile: cur.Record.MediaFile, Seq: cur.Record.Seq, State: schema.ProbeProbed, Path: f.path,
		ProbeHash: steady.Status.ProbeHash, ProbeVersion: mediainfo.ProbeVersion, RequestedVersion: mediainfo.ProbeVersion,
		ProbedAt: time.Now().UTC(), MediaInfo: fakeMediaInfo(),
	})
	reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
	assert.Equal(t, f.path, f.get(t).Spec.Path)

	h.answer(t, uid, &commonv1.MediaInfo{Container: "mp4", VideoCodec: "hevc"})
	reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
	got = f.get(t)
	assert.Equal(t, target, got.Spec.Path)
	require.NotNil(t, got.Status.Transcode)
	assert.True(t, got.Status.Transcode.Compliant)
	assert.True(t, got.ProbeCurrent())
}

// An audio graft's swap is asked for like a transcode swap: until a record of
// the file's new bytes lands nothing is recorded or taken over and the file
// reads ProbePending; then the graft tag is recorded and the size, mtime and
// path are taken over -- never spec.original, a graft is not a transcode. A
// graft whose new bytes a record already describes (probed and incorporated
// before squasharr reported the graft) is recorded from it without a probe.
func TestAGraftIsIncorporatedOnlyFromARecordOfItsNewBytes(t *testing.T) {
	f := newQueuedFile(t, "probe-graft")
	ctx := t.Context()
	h := newProbeHarness(t)
	r := h.reconciler(f.c)
	uid := f.uid(t)
	reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
	h.answer(t, uid, fakeMediaInfo())
	reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
	steady := f.get(t)
	require.NotEmpty(t, steady.Status.ProbeHash)

	// squasharr's graft Job rewrote the file in place.
	grafted := []byte("stand-in bytes, with an English dub muxed in")
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(f.path, grafted, 0o644))
	succeededGraft(t, ctx, f.c, f.key.Namespace, f.key.Name, "61d29fba5193")

	reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
	got := f.get(t)
	assert.Empty(t, got.Status.GraftTag, "nothing is recorded before the new bytes' probe lands")
	assert.Equal(t, steady.Spec.SizeBytes, got.Spec.SizeBytes, "nothing is taken over before the new bytes' probe lands")
	assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileReasonProbePending, reasonOf(got, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileConditionProbed))
	assert.False(t, got.ProbeCurrent())
	cur := h.record(t, uid)
	require.Equal(t, schema.ProbeRequested, cur.Record.State)
	assert.Equal(t, "high", cur.Record.Lane)

	h.answer(t, uid, fakeMediaInfo())
	reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
	got = f.get(t)
	assert.Equal(t, "61d29fba5193", got.Status.GraftTag)
	require.NotNil(t, got.Status.GraftedAt)
	assert.EqualValues(t, len(grafted), got.Spec.SizeBytes, "catalogarr takes the grafted size over")
	require.NotNil(t, got.Spec.Original)
	assert.True(t, *got.Spec.Original, "a graft is not a transcode")
	assert.Nil(t, got.Status.Transcode)
	assert.True(t, got.ProbeCurrent())

	// The next graft's bytes are probed and incorporated before squasharr
	// reports it (a rescan's fingerprint woke the file first).
	regrafted := []byte("stand-in bytes, with English and French dubs muxed in")
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(f.path, regrafted, 0o644))
	reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
	h.answer(t, uid, fakeMediaInfo())
	reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
	require.EqualValues(t, len(regrafted), f.get(t).Spec.SizeBytes, "setup: a grafted original's size stays catalogarr's")
	succeededGraft(t, ctx, f.c, f.key.Namespace, f.key.Name, "0a1b2c3d4e5f")
	before := len(h.sent())
	reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
	got = f.get(t)
	assert.Equal(t, "0a1b2c3d4e5f", got.Status.GraftTag, "recorded from the record that already describes the bytes")
	assert.Len(t, h.sent(), before, "no probe is asked for bytes a record already describes")
	assert.True(t, got.ProbeCurrent())
}

func TestAProbeRequestIsRepublishedOnlyInsideTheDedupWindow(t *testing.T) {
	f := newQueuedFile(t, "probe-republish")
	h := newProbeHarness(t)
	r := h.reconciler(f.c)
	clock := time.Now()
	r.Clock = func() time.Time { return clock }
	h.store.Now = r.Clock

	res := reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
	assert.InDelta(t, mediafile.ProbeRequestTimeoutHigh.Seconds(), res.RequeueAfter.Seconds(), 1)
	require.Len(t, h.sent(), 1)
	assert.False(t, h.sent()[0].Duplicate)

	clock = clock.Add(10 * time.Minute)
	reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
	sent := h.sent()
	require.Len(t, sent, 2, "republished inside the window: it covers a publish that failed")
	assert.Equal(t, sent[0].MsgID, sent[1].MsgID)
	assert.True(t, sent[1].Duplicate, "the stream absorbs the republish")

	clock = clock.Add(mediafile.ProbeRepublishWindow) // 60 m after the request
	reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
	assert.Len(t, h.sent(), 2, "no republish once the dedup window may have passed")
	assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileReasonProbePending, reasonOf(f.get(t), catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileConditionProbed))
}

func TestAFailedProbeRetriesOnItsBackoff(t *testing.T) {
	f := newQueuedFile(t, "probe-backoff")
	h := newProbeHarness(t)
	r := h.reconciler(f.c)
	clock := time.Now()
	r.Clock = func() time.Time { return clock }
	h.store.Now = r.Clock
	uid := f.uid(t)

	reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
	h.answerWith(t, uid, schema.ProbeRecord{State: schema.ProbeFailed, Transient: true, Failure: "ffprobe: timed out", ProbedAt: clock})
	clock = clock.Add(time.Minute)
	res := reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
	got := f.get(t)
	assert.Equal(t, "ProbeFailed", reasonOf(got, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileConditionProbed))
	assert.Contains(t, k8s.FindCondition(got.Status.Conditions, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileConditionProbed).Message, "timed out")
	assert.InDelta(t, (mediafile.ProbeTransientRetry - time.Minute).Seconds(), res.RequeueAfter.Seconds(), 1)
	require.Len(t, h.sent(), 1, "not asked again before the retry is due")

	clock = clock.Add(5 * time.Minute)
	reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
	require.Len(t, h.sent(), 2, "a transient failure is asked again after 5 m")
	assert.EqualValues(t, 2, h.record(t, uid).Record.Seq)

	h.answerWith(t, uid, schema.ProbeRecord{State: schema.ProbeFailed, Failure: "Invalid data found when processing input", ProbedAt: clock})
	clock = clock.Add(time.Minute)
	res = reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
	assert.InDelta(t, (mediafile.ProbeFailedRetry - time.Minute).Seconds(), res.RequeueAfter.Seconds(), 1)
	assert.Len(t, h.sent(), 2)
}

func TestAnOlderAgentsResultIsNotRequestedAgainAtOnce(t *testing.T) {
	f := newQueuedFile(t, "probe-skew")
	mediafile.SetProbeVersion(t, mediainfo.ProbeVersion+1)
	h := newProbeHarness(t)
	r := h.reconciler(f.c)
	clock := time.Now()
	r.Clock = func() time.Time { return clock }
	h.store.Now = r.Clock
	uid := f.uid(t)

	reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
	require.Len(t, h.sent(), 1)
	h.answerWith(t, uid, schema.ProbeRecord{State: schema.ProbeProbed, ProbeVersion: mediainfo.ProbeVersion, ProbedAt: clock, MediaInfo: fakeMediaInfo()})
	clock = clock.Add(time.Minute)
	res := reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
	got := f.get(t)
	require.NotNil(t, got.Status.MediaInfo, "a new file is incorporated from an older agent's answer")
	assert.Equal(t, mediainfo.ProbeVersion, got.Status.ProbeVersion, "and stays due by version")
	assert.True(t, got.ProbeCurrent())
	assert.InDelta(t, (mediafile.ProbeSkewRetry - time.Minute).Seconds(), res.RequeueAfter.Seconds(), 1)
	assert.Len(t, h.sent(), 1, "never asked again at once")

	clock = clock.Add(10 * time.Minute)
	reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
	assert.Len(t, h.sent(), 1, "the older agent's answer is waited out")

	clock = clock.Add(20 * time.Minute) // 31 m after the answer
	reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
	sent := h.sent()
	require.Len(t, sent, 2)
	assert.Contains(t, sent[1].Subject, ".low.")
}

func TestAProbeAbandonedThreeTimesIsGivenUp(t *testing.T) {
	f := newQueuedFile(t, "probe-abandoned")
	h := newProbeHarness(t)
	r := h.reconciler(f.c)
	clock := time.Now()
	r.Clock = func() time.Time { return clock }
	h.store.Now = r.Clock
	uid := f.uid(t)

	reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
	for i := 1; i <= 3; i++ {
		h.answerWith(t, uid, schema.ProbeRecord{State: schema.ProbeFailed, Abandoned: true, Failure: "stuck in the demuxer", ProbedAt: clock})
		clock = clock.Add(61 * time.Minute)
		reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
		if i < 3 {
			require.Len(t, h.sent(), i+1, "abandon %d is asked again after the hour", i)
		}
	}
	got := f.get(t)
	c := k8s.FindCondition(got.Status.Conditions, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileConditionProbed)
	require.NotNil(t, c)
	assert.Equal(t, "ProbeFailed", c.Reason)
	assert.Equal(t, "probe abandoned 3 times: stuck in the demuxer", c.Message)
	clock = clock.Add(24 * time.Hour)
	reconcileOnce(t, r, f.key)
	assert.Len(t, h.sent(), 3, "given up: only new bytes or a ProbeVersion raise ask again")
}
```

3a. `incorporate.go` (package `mediafile`; imports `context`, `fmt`, `time`,

```go
// incorporation is what a reconcile knows about the file when it folds a
// probe's summary into status.
type incorporation struct {
	path       string // the file: spec.path, or a transcode swap's target
	ps         probeState
	swap, kept *transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob
	graft      *transcodev1alpha1.AudioGraft // an audio graft's swap (graft.go): new bytes, never a transcode
	transcoded bool // spec.original was false before this reconcile
	now        metav1.Time
}

// incorporated is what folding a summary in did, for Reconcile's Events.
type incorporated struct {
	probed     bool
	changed    bool
	keptOutput string
}

// incorporate folds mi -- a summary of in.path's current bytes by probe
// version version, from the probe record or, for a kept job, from status --
// into known and conditions, and applies catalogarr's labels and, from the
// first swap on, the spec fields it owns, in one k8s.Apply. It is the block
// Reconcile ran after its own probe before the probe queue (spec 2026-10-06
// §6.5.3, "today's success block, unchanged").
func (r *Reconciler) incorporate(ctx context.Context, mf *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile, conditions *[]metav1.Condition,
	known *knownStatus, in incorporation, mi *commonv1.MediaInfo, version int32) (incorporated, error) {
	log := logging.FromContext(ctx)
	out := incorporated{probed: true}
	original := mf.Spec.Original == nil || *mf.Spec.Original
	if in.swap != nil {
		original = false
	}
	if in.graft != nil {
		// An audio graft rewrote the file in place (anime dual-audio spec
		// §7.2): not a transcode -- spec.original stays -- but its bytes are
		// new, and this summary is of them.
		known.GraftTag, known.GraftedAt = in.graft.Status.GraftTag, &in.now
	}
	labels := mirrorLabels(mf.Spec.MediaRef.Kind, mf.Spec.Quality, mi, original)
	mainAC := catalogac.MediaFile(mf.Name, mf.Namespace).WithLabels(labels)
	if original && known.GraftTag != "" {
		// A grafted original: the size, mtime and path are catalogarr's
		// from its first graft on, re-sent on every apply as after a
		// transcode -- and spec.original is never sent, so importarr
		// keeps it (a graft is not a transcode).
		mainAC = mainAC.WithSpec(catalogac.MediaFileSpec().
			WithPath(in.path).
			WithSizeBytes(in.ps.SizeBytes).
			WithModTime(in.ps.ModTime))
	}
	if !original {
		mainAC = mainAC.WithSpec(catalogac.MediaFileSpec().
			WithPath(in.path).
			WithSizeBytes(in.ps.SizeBytes).
			WithModTime(in.ps.ModTime).
			WithOriginal(false))
	}
	if _, err := k8s.Apply(ctx, r.Client, k8s.ManagerCatalogarr, mainAC); err != nil {
		return out, err
	}
	if in.swap != nil {
		log.Info("incorporated transcode swap", "transcodeJob", in.swap.Name)
	}
	if in.graft != nil {
		log.Info("incorporated audio graft", "audioGraft", in.graft.Name, "graftTag", in.graft.Status.GraftTag)
	}
	k8s.MarkTrue(mf, conditions, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileConditionProbed, "Probed", "probed at %s", in.now.Time)
	k8s.MarkTrue(mf, conditions, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileConditionReady, "Ready", "file present and probed")
	known.ProbeHash = in.ps.Hash
	known.ProbedAt = &in.now
	known.ProbeVersion = version
	known.MediaInfo = mi
	if in.swap == nil && in.kept == nil && in.graft == nil && in.transcoded && bytesChanged(mf, in.ps) && mf.Status.ProbeHash != "" {
		known.Transcode = staleTranscodeState(known.Transcode)
		out.changed = true
	}
	if in.swap != nil {
		profileTag, err := r.transcodeProfileTag(ctx, in.swap)
		if err != nil {
			return out, err
		}
		known.Transcode = &catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeState{Compliant: true, ProfileTag: profileTag, LastResult: catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeResultSucceeded}
		if in.path != mf.Spec.Path {
			log.Info("followed a transcode to its new path", "from", mf.Spec.Path, "to", in.path)
		}
	}
	if in.kept != nil {
		profileTag, err := r.transcodeProfileTag(ctx, in.kept)
		if err != nil {
			return out, err
		}
		known.Transcode = &catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeState{ProfileTag: profileTag, LastResult: catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeResultSucceeded}
		out.keptOutput = in.kept.Status.Result.OutputPath
	}
	return out, nil
}

// pending reports a queued, unanswered probe of a new file, changed bytes or a
// transcode swap's target: Probed and Ready False, ProbePending, every other
// field re-sent as it stands (the complete declaration), naming held. Labels
// and the spec takeover wait for the incorporation.
func (r *Reconciler) pending(ctx context.Context, mf *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile, conditions []metav1.Condition,
	known *knownStatus, probeStale, transcodePending bool, rec schema.ProbeRecord, res ctrl.Result) (ctrl.Result, error) {
	msg := fmt.Sprintf("probe requested %s (%s)", rec.RequestedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339), rec.Lane)
	k8s.MarkFalse(mf, &conditions, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileConditionProbed, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileReasonProbePending, "%s", msg)
	k8s.MarkFalse(mf, &conditions, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileConditionReady, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileReasonProbePending, "%s", msg)
	var retryNaming bool
	known.Naming, retryNaming = r.renderNaming(ctx, mf, known, namingInputs{
		specPath: mf.Spec.Path, probeStale: probeStale, transcodePending: transcodePending,
	})
	if err := r.applyStatus(ctx, mf, conditions, known); err != nil {
		return ctrl.Result{}, err
	}
	return withNamingRetry(res, retryNaming), nil
}

// probeFailed reports a failed probe, or one given up on, without releasing
// what the last good probe recorded: the ProbeFailed branch of before the
// queue, with the import domain's failure as its message.
func (r *Reconciler) probeFailed(ctx context.Context, mf *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile, conditions []metav1.Condition,
	known *knownStatus, probeStale, transcodePending bool, j judgement, now time.Time) (ctrl.Result, error) {
	k8s.MarkFalse(mf, &conditions, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileConditionProbed, "ProbeFailed", "%s", j.failure)
	k8s.MarkFalse(mf, &conditions, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileConditionReady, "ProbeFailed", "probe failed: %s", j.failure)
	var retryNaming bool
	known.Naming, retryNaming = r.renderNaming(ctx, mf, known, namingInputs{
		specPath: mf.Spec.Path, probeStale: probeStale, transcodePending: transcodePending,
	})
	if err := r.applyStatus(ctx, mf, conditions, known); err != nil {
		return ctrl.Result{}, err
	}
	return withNamingRetry(requeueAt(ctrl.Result{}, j.requeueAt, now), retryNaming), nil
}

// ask runs a request or pending verdict: Request and Publish for a request (a
// lost compare-and-swap is conflict), a same-Msg-Id republish inside the
// window for a pending one. It returns the record the status reports.
func (r *Reconciler) ask(ctx context.Context, want probestore.Want, cur probestore.Current, j judgement) (schema.ProbeRecord, bool, error) {
	if j.verdict == verdictPending {
		if j.republish {
			if err := r.Probes.Publish(ctx, cur.Record); err != nil {
				return cur.Record, false, err
			}
		}
		return cur.Record, false, nil
	}
	want.Lane = j.lane
	rec, err := r.Probes.Request(ctx, want, cur)
	if errors.Is(err, probestore.ErrConflict) {
		return rec, true, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return rec, false, err
	}
	if err := r.Probes.Publish(ctx, rec); err != nil {
		return rec, false, err
	}
	metrics.ProbeRequestsTotal.WithLabelValues(rec.Lane).Inc()
	return rec, false, nil
}
```

```go
	in := incorporation{path: path, ps: ps, swap: swap, kept: kept, graft: graft, transcoded: transcoded, now: now}
	// An audio graft's swap is asked for like a transcode swap's: its bytes
	// are new, so it is never path-only or version-only, it is probed on the
	// high lane, and a record that already describes them is incorporated
	// at once (graft.go).
	swapOrKept := swap != nil || kept != nil || graft != nil
	var inc incorporated
	var res ctrl.Result
	switch {
	case pathOnly(&mf, ps, swapOrKept):
		// The bytes status.mediaInfo describes, under a new name: record the
		// new hash and the container the name says, and probe nothing.
		known.ProbeHash = ps.Hash
		known.MediaInfo = mediainfo.AtPath(mf.Status.MediaInfo, path)
		known.ProbedAt = &now
		if mf.Status.ProbeVersion < probeVersion {
			// A status write wakes no reconcile: the version-only re-probe is
			// the next one's to request, a second from now.
			res = sooner(res, time.Second)
		}
	case keptNeedsNoProbe(&mf, ps, kept != nil):
		if inc, err = r.incorporate(ctx, &mf, &conditions, known, in, mf.Status.MediaInfo, mf.Status.ProbeVersion); err != nil {
			return ctrl.Result{}, err
		}
	case swapOrKept || probeDue(mf.Status.ProbeHash, mf.Status.ProbeVersion, ps):
		if r.Probes == nil {
			return ctrl.Result{}, errors.New("mediafile: the reconciler has no probe store")
		}
		want := probestore.Want{
			MediaFile:    schema.Ref{Namespace: mf.Namespace, Name: mf.Name, UID: string(mf.UID)},
			Path:         path,
			ProbeHash:    ps.Hash,
			ProbeVersion: probeVersion,
			Lane:         probeLane(&mf, ps, swapOrKept),
		}
		cur, err := r.Probes.Get(ctx, string(mf.UID))
		if err != nil {
			return ctrl.Result{}, err
		}
		j := judgeProbe(cur.Record, cur.OK, want, mf.Status.ProbeHash, now.Time)
		switch j.verdict {
		case verdictIncorporate:
			if inc, err = r.incorporate(ctx, &mf, &conditions, known, in, cur.Record.MediaInfo, cur.Record.ProbeVersion); err != nil {
				return ctrl.Result{}, err
			}
			res = requeueAt(res, j.requeueAt, now.Time)
		case verdictWait:
			res = requeueAt(res, j.requeueAt, now.Time)
		case verdictFailed, verdictGiveUp:
			return r.probeFailed(ctx, &mf, conditions, known, ps.Stale, swap != nil || transcodeRunning, j, now.Time)
		case verdictRequest, verdictPending:
			rec, conflict, err := r.ask(ctx, want, cur, j)
			if err != nil {
				return ctrl.Result{}, err
			}
			if conflict {
				return ctrl.Result{RequeueAfter: probeConflictRetry}, nil
			}
			res = requeueAt(res, j.requeueAt, now.Time)
			if !versionOnly(&mf, ps, swapOrKept) {
				return r.pending(ctx, &mf, conditions, known, ps.Stale || mf.Status.ProbeHash == "", swap != nil || transcodeRunning, rec, res)
			}
		}
	}
```

### Task W4.14: downstream readers hold off while a probe is pending

**Spec:** §6.5.3 "Downstream gates" (`transcodeprofile.probed`, the
TranscodeJob reconcile, captionarr's profile and request controllers,
`segmenting.Applier.ApplyMerged`, now `segmentresults`); §6.8
(`TestAJobIsNotDispatchedWhileItsFilesProbeIsPending`,
`TestAFileWhoseProbeIsPendingIsNotQueued` and the captionarr equivalent,
`TestAnUpdateForAFileWhoseProbeIsPendingIsDropped`). Plus the AudioGraft
controller, which landed after the spec (drift).

**Two departures, reported as spec defects:**
- The TranscodeJob gate the spec places in `plan()` (after the
  `MediaInfo == nil` check) holds only a Pending job: `plan()` runs for Pending
  jobs, and its `r.wait` sets Pending. A job already Planned when its file's
  bytes change is admitted and dispatched without passing `plan()`. So the
  gate is also in admission's candidate loop (a Planned job whose file's probe
  is pending is not a candidate: it stays Planned and takes no slot) and, as a
  belt for the race between admission's read and the dispatch, in `dispatch`.
- The AudioGraft controller (drift) reads `status.mediaInfo.audio`. Gating it in
  `file()` would call `wait()` during its own swap's re-probe, which flips a
  Succeeded graft to Waiting; the graft incorporation catalogarr runs (main's
  `unincorporatedGraft`) keys on Succeeded. So a Succeeded graft keeps its phase
  while the probe is pending, and only a graft that has not run waits.

```go
func TestAJobIsNotDispatchedWhileItsFilesProbeIsPending(t *testing.T) {
	_, c := startEnv(t)
	const ns = "tj-probe-pending"
	newNamespace(t, c, ns)
	newRootFolder(t, c, ns, "/data/media/movies")
	tp := newProfile(t, c, "hevc", "hash1", nil)
	r := newReconciler(t, c, map[string]int32{"cpu": 1})

	// A Pending job waits for the probe.
	newMediaFile(t, c, ns, "heat", "probe1", nil)
	setProbePending(t, c, ns, "heat", "probe1", h264Probe())
	newTJ(t, c, ns, "heat-hevc", "heat", "hevc", "probe1", nil)
	reconcileTJ(t, r, ns, "heat-hevc")
	got := getTJ(t, c, ns, "heat-hevc")
	assert.Equal(t, transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobPhasePending, got.Status.Phase)
	assert.Contains(t, got.Status.Message, "re-probed")

	// A Planned job whose file goes pending stays Planned and takes no slot.
	newMediaFile(t, c, ns, "ronin", "probe2", ptr.To(h264Probe()))
	newTJ(t, c, ns, "ronin-hevc", "ronin", "hevc", "probe2", nil)
	reconcileTJ(t, newReconciler(t, c, map[string]int32{"cpu": 0}), ns, "ronin-hevc")
	require.Equal(t, transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobPhasePlanned, getTJ(t, c, ns, "ronin-hevc").Status.Phase)
	setProbePending(t, c, ns, "ronin", "probe2", h264Probe())
	reconcileTJ(t, r, ns, "ronin-hevc")
	got = getTJ(t, c, ns, "ronin-hevc")
	assert.Equal(t, transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobPhasePlanned, got.Status.Phase)
	assert.EqualValues(t, 0, got.Status.Attempts, "no slot, no dispatch")
	assert.Empty(t, takeTasks(t, r.Bus, tp.UID, "cpu", 300*time.Millisecond))

	// Once the probe lands it is dispatched.
	setProbe(t, c, ns, "ronin", "probe2", h264Probe())
	reconcileTJ(t, r, ns, "ronin-hevc")
	assert.Equal(t, transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobPhaseQueued, getTJ(t, c, ns, "ronin-hevc").Status.Phase)
}
```

```go
func TestAGraftWaitsForAFileWhoseProbeIsPending(t *testing.T) {

// The graft's own swap is re-probed through the queue; meanwhile the graft
// stays Succeeded, which catalogarr incorporates the swap from.
func TestASucceededGraftStaysSucceededWhileItsFilesProbeIsPending(t *testing.T) {
	f := newFixture(t, "graft-swap-pending")
	mf := f.episode("monster-s01e02", "jpn")
	g := f.reconcile(f.graft("monster-s01e02"))
	job := f.jobs()[0]
	f.finish(&job, grafttask.Result{
		Phase: grafttask.PhaseSucceeded, Reason: grafttask.ReasonGrafted, RateName: "1", RateMicros: 1000000,
		CoveragePercent: 96, Within80Percent: 100, GraftTag: "61d29fba5193",
		Segments: []grafttask.Segment{{DonorStartMillis: 0, TargetStartMillis: 1000, LengthMillis: 1434580}},
	})
	g = f.reconcile(g)
	require.Equal(t, transcodev1alpha1.AudioGraftSucceeded, g.Status.Phase)
	f.probePending(mf)
	g = f.reconcile(g)
	assert.Equal(t, transcodev1alpha1.AudioGraftSucceeded, g.Status.Phase)
	assert.Equal(t, "61d29fba5193", g.Status.GraftTag)
}
```

```go
// probeCurrent reports whether tj's MediaFile's summary describes its bytes
// (MediaFile.ProbeCurrent). A job whose file is being re-probed waits Planned
// and takes no slot (spec 2026-10-06 §6.5.3). A MediaFile that cannot be read
// is left to dispatch, which handles a missing one.
func (r *Reconciler) probeCurrent(ctx context.Context, tj *transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob) bool {
	var mf catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
	if err := r.Client.Get(ctx, types.NamespacedName{Namespace: tj.Namespace, Name: tj.Spec.MediaFileRef}, &mf); err != nil {
		return true
	}
	return mf.ProbeCurrent()
}
```

## Wave 4b: the indexarr split (R8)

**Spec:** §5.12 (the indexarr split), §5.3.2 (`indexarr` becomes manager-only),
§5.5 (session Save/Drop row), §5.15 (the guards this wave owns), §13 OD14 and
OD15, R7, R8 (amended), R9 (bundle loader). Build order step 5 (§11.1): it
depends on Wave 3 only.

**What this wave does.** After it, the manager's Indexer reconciler paces its
caps probes and logins on its own limiter and holds no reference to any client
cache. The index agent builds its own `clientcache.ClientCache`, limiter and
session store. It applies each Indexer's `spec.requestDelay` itself, gated on
generation. It learns about session changes through the
`clustarr-indexer-sessions` KV (`WatchSessions`), and about deletions through
`Prune`. Its session writes run under `indexarr-worker`, and its `Drop` is a
compare-and-swap. The manager enqueues an Indexer when its session key is
deleted (`sessionsSource`). The bundle loader is leader-only and the release
index sweeper runs on every replica.

### Preconditions (produced by Waves 2 and 3)

Run before W4.20. Every line must print what the comment says. If Wave 3 used a
different spelling for something below, use Wave 3's spelling. The tasks name
each change by its effect and give the `grep` that finds the site.

```bash
cd /home/appkins/src/mediactl/clustarr-unify
for d in clients clientcache rssschedule controller/directgrab manager agent; do test -d app/indexer/$d || echo "MISSING app/indexer/$d"; done   # prints nothing
grep -n 'func NewSessionStore' app/indexer/clients/session.go                  # NewSessionStore(c client.Client, bus events.Bus)
grep -n 'func NewClientCache\|func buildWireClientFor\|func reloginFunc' app/indexer/clientcache/clientcache.go   # three hits
grep -n 'ForgetClient' app/indexer/controller/indexer/controller.go app/indexer/controller/indexer/controller_definition.go   # the X3 hook: field + two calls
grep -rn 'type LeaderOnly' pkg/k8s/                                              # k8s.LeaderOnly exists
ls app/indexer/agent/facadekey.go app/indexer/facadekey.go 2>/dev/null          # where ensureFacadeAPIKeys lives now
go list -deps ./app/indexer/controller/indexer | grep -c 'modernc.org/sqlite\|app/indexer/clientcache'   # 0
```

**Names consumed:**

- **X2, `app/indexer/clients`:**
  - `Client` and `CardigannClient`, with the relogin hook that
    `clientcache.reloginFunc` sets.
  - `SessionStore{Client client.Client; KV events.KV}`,
    `NewSessionStore(c, bus)`, `SessionKey`, `SessionSecretName`,
    `SessionSecretKeySession`, `SessionSecretKeyCookie`.
  - `ApplyRateLimit(spec, def, lim, floor)`, `ResolveSource`,
    `SourceGeneric`, `ReadSecret`, `ResolveDefinition`, `DefinitionDelay`,
    `BuildClient`, `BuildCardigann`.
  - The unexported `defaultRequestDelay`, `ownedBy`, `sessionSecretAC` and
    `renewSession`.
- **X3, `app/indexer/clientcache`:**
  - `ClientCache` (fields `Sessions`, `TTL`, `Now`), `NewClientCache(c, lim)`
    and `DefaultClientCacheTTL`.
  - Methods `For`, `DefinitionFetcherFor`, `Limiters`, `Forget` and `Len`.
  - The unexported `buildWireClient`, `buildWireClientFor`, `reloginFunc`,
    `lookup`, `store` and `clientEntry`.
  - `indexer.Reconciler.ForgetClient func(types.UID)`.
- **Wave 3:**
  - `app/indexer/manager.Register(mgr ctrl.Manager, bus events.Bus, o Options) error`,
    with `Options.CardigannBundled` and `Options.CardigannDefinitionsDir`.
  - The `app/indexer/agent` registration (package `agent`; its `Register` as
    Wave 3 shaped it per §3.5.2), which opens relindex and registers the RPC
    verbs, the RSS worker, the facade (`ensureFacadeAPIKeys`, `facadekey.go`)
    and `indexSweeper`.
  - `k8s.LeaderOnly`.
  - `app/indexer/run.go` as the `--role all` shim that calls both registrations.

### Wave-specific rules

- **Commit pathspecs name files, never `git diff --name-only`.** Two tasks the
  order lets run beside this wave edit under its trees: W4.42 (Wave 4c) edits
  `app/indexer/worker/rss/publish_test.go`, and W4.7 (Wave 4a) edits
  `cmd/clustarr/deploy_args_test.go`. A pathspec built from `git diff --name-only`
  would sweep their uncommitted hunks into a 4b commit (CLAUDE.md's git-index
  gotcha). So each 4b task commits the files its Files list names, plus the
  files its own Step 3 `grep` selects, computed from that `grep`'s pattern (a file
  holding the pattern is one this task had to edit). And W4.42 does not run
  while a 4b task has uncommitted changes under `app/indexer/worker/rss`: it runs
  between two 4b tasks. No 4b task edits `cmd/clustarr/deploy_args_test.go`.
- **No `go.mod` change.** `k8s.io/client-go/util/retry` and
  `sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client/interceptor` are already in the
  module graph.
- **No new field manager, no renamed durable or bucket, no RBAC marker moved.**
  The Drop's live Get and its compare-and-swap apply are covered by the
  existing `secrets get;create;patch` marker. `make generate manifests` must

```go
// Since the split the owned session Secret has two writers in two processes
// (§5.3.2), so a store must say which one it is. One with no name refuses to
// write anything rather than apply under a name the guard cannot attribute.
func TestASessionStoreWithoutAManagerRefusesToWrite(t *testing.T) {
	c := fake.NewClientBuilder().WithScheme(k8s.MustNewScheme()).Build()
	idx := &indexv1alpha1.Indexer{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "nameless", Namespace: "media", UID: "uid-nameless"}}
	store := clients.NewSessionStore(c, nil, "")

	err := store.Save(t.Context(), idx, &cardigann.Session{Cookies: []*http.Cookie{{Name: "uid", Value: "s"}}})
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "empty field manager")

	var sec corev1.Secret
	err = c.Get(t.Context(), types.NamespacedName{Namespace: "media", Name: clients.SessionSecretName("nameless")}, &sec)
	require.True(t, apierrors.IsNotFound(err), "a store with no field manager wrote the Secret anyway: %v", err)
}

// NewSessionStore keeps the manager its caller names. The field-manager guard
// (§5.15) attributes every session write to the package of that call.
func TestNewSessionStoreKeepsItsManager(t *testing.T) {
	for _, fm := range []k8s.FieldManager{k8s.ManagerIndexarr, k8s.ManagerIndexarrWorker} {
		require.Equal(t, fm, clients.NewSessionStore(nil, nil, fm).Manager)
	}
}
```

```go
/* GPL header from hack/boilerplate.go.txt, as above */

package clients_test

import (

)

// sessionEnvtest starts a control plane for one test. It does not rely on a
// package TestMain, so it works whichever envtest suite this package has.
// It skips without KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS, and a skip is not a pass. The test
// needs a real apiserver because managedFields and resourceVersion conflicts
// exist only there.
func sessionEnvtest(t *testing.T) client.Client {
	t.Helper()
	if os.Getenv("KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS") == "" {
		t.Skip("KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS is unset; run via `make test`")
	}
	env := &envtest.Environment{
		CRDDirectoryPaths:     []string{filepath.Join("..", "..", "..", "config", "crd", "bases")},
		ErrorIfCRDPathMissing: true,
	}
	cfg, err := env.Start()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, env.Stop()) })
	c, err := client.New(cfg, client.Options{Scheme: k8s.MustNewScheme()})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	return c
}

// sessionIndexer creates a real Indexer, so the Secret's owner reference
// carries an apiserver-minted UID.
func sessionIndexer(t *testing.T, c client.Client, ns, name string) *indexv1alpha1.Indexer {
	t.Helper()
	ctx := t.Context()
	require.NoError(t, client.IgnoreAlreadyExists(c.Create(ctx, &corev1.Namespace{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: ns}})))
	idx := &indexv1alpha1.Indexer{
		ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: name, Namespace: ns},
		Spec: indexv1alpha1.IndexerSpec{
			BaseURL: "https://tracker.invalid",
			Generic: &indexv1alpha1.GenericNewznab{Protocol: commonv1alpha1.ProtocolTorrent},
		},
	}
	require.NoError(t, c.Create(ctx, idx))
	return idx
}

// readSessionSecret reads the owned Secret through c. c is a direct client,
// so managedFields are not stripped.
func readSessionSecret(t *testing.T, c client.Client, idx *indexv1alpha1.Indexer) *corev1.Secret {
	t.Helper()
	var sec corev1.Secret
	require.NoError(t, c.Get(t.Context(),
		types.NamespacedName{Namespace: idx.Namespace, Name: clients.SessionSecretName(idx.Name)}, &sec))
	return &sec
}

// ownsField reports whether manager's managedFields entry on sec holds path,
// for example ownsField(t, sec, k8s.ManagerIndexarr, "f:data", "f:session").
// Forced ownership (pkg/k8s/patch.go) makes a double claim silent, so the
// tests below assert ownership by manager name. Values alone cannot show an
// over-claim.
func ownsField(t *testing.T, sec *corev1.Secret, manager k8s.FieldManager, path ...string) bool {
	t.Helper()
	for _, mf := range sec.ManagedFields {
		if mf.Manager != manager.String() || mf.FieldsV1 == nil {
			continue
		}
		var node map[string]any
		require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(mf.FieldsV1.Raw, &node))
		found := true
		for _, p := range path {
			next, ok := node[p].(map[string]any)
			if !ok {
				found = false
				break
			}
			node = next
		}
		if found {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// sessionOf is a session whose one cookie is uid=<cookie>.
func sessionOf(cookie string) *cardigann.Session {
	return &cardigann.Session{
		Cookies:   []*http.Cookie{{Name: "uid", Value: cookie}},
		ExpiresAt: time.Date(2026, 11, 6, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	}
}

// Each process's Save lands under its own manager. Both send
// sessionSecretAC's one complete declaration, so each Save takes the two data
// keys from the other and neither can release a field (§5.3.2). This is the
// only deliberate co-ownership the split introduces.
func TestSessionSaveRecordsItsFieldManager(t *testing.T) {
	c := sessionEnvtest(t)
	ctx := t.Context()
	idx := sessionIndexer(t, c, "session-owner", "owner")
	agent := clients.NewSessionStore(c, nil, k8s.ManagerIndexarrWorker)
	mgr := clients.NewSessionStore(c, nil, k8s.ManagerIndexarr)

	require.NoError(t, agent.Save(ctx, idx, sessionOf("agent-1")))
	sec := readSessionSecret(t, c, idx)
	require.True(t, ownsField(t, sec, k8s.ManagerIndexarrWorker, "f:data", "f:session"))
	require.True(t, ownsField(t, sec, k8s.ManagerIndexarrWorker, "f:data", "f:cookie"))
	require.False(t, ownsField(t, sec, k8s.ManagerIndexarr, "f:data", "f:session"),
		"the agent's relogin Save was recorded under indexarr, which is the manager's alone since the split")

	require.NoError(t, mgr.Save(ctx, idx, sessionOf("manager-1")))
	sec = readSessionSecret(t, c, idx)
	require.True(t, ownsField(t, sec, k8s.ManagerIndexarr, "f:data", "f:session"))
	require.True(t, ownsField(t, sec, k8s.ManagerIndexarr, "f:data", "f:cookie"))
	require.True(t, ownsField(t, sec, k8s.ManagerIndexarr, "f:metadata", "f:ownerReferences"))
	require.True(t, ownsField(t, sec, k8s.ManagerIndexarr, "f:type"))
	require.False(t, ownsField(t, sec, k8s.ManagerIndexarrWorker, "f:data", "f:session"),
		"the manager's Save changed data.session yet left indexarr-worker owning it")
	require.Equal(t, "uid=manager-1", string(sec.Data[clients.SessionSecretKeyCookie]))
}
```

```go
type SessionStore struct {
	Client client.Client
	KV     events.KV

	// Manager is the field manager the owned Secret is applied under:
	// k8s.ManagerIndexarr in the manager (the Indexer reconciler's logins) and
	// k8s.ManagerIndexarrWorker in the index agent (a cached client's relogin
	// Save and its Drop). Both apply sessionSecretAC's one complete
	// declaration, so neither can release a field the other set: the only
	// deliberate co-ownership of the manager/agent split (§5.3.2). Empty
	// refuses every Secret write (k8s.FieldManager.Validate).
	Manager k8s.FieldManager
}

// NewSessionStore returns a store over c that writes the Secret as manager
// and, when bus is non-nil, mirrors into its clustarr-indexer-sessions bucket.
func NewSessionStore(c client.Client, bus events.Bus, manager k8s.FieldManager) *SessionStore {
	s := &SessionStore{Client: c, Manager: manager}
	if bus != nil {
		s.KV = bus.KV(events.BucketIndexerSessions)
	}
	return s
}
```

`k8s.Apply(ctx, s.Client, k8s.ManagerIndexarr, ac)` to
`k8s.Apply(ctx, s.Client, s.Manager, ac)`. In the doc comments of `Save`,
`Drop` and `sessionSecretAC`, "under k8s.ManagerIndexarr" becomes "under
s.Manager". `Save` already writes the Secret before KV, so a failed

```go
package clients_test

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"sync"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"

	indexv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/index/v1alpha1"
	"github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/indexer/clients"
	"github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/cardigann"
	"github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/events"
	"github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/events/membus"
	"github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/k8s"
)

// sessionsKV is a clustarr-indexer-sessions bucket on an in-memory bus with
// the production topology.
func sessionsKV(t *testing.T) events.KV {
	t.Helper()
	bus := membus.New(nil)
	require.NoError(t, bus.Ensure(t.Context(), events.Default().ForSingleNode()))
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = bus.Close() })
	return bus.KV(events.BucketIndexerSessions)
}

// kvSession is idx's session in kv, or nil when its key is absent.
func kvSession(t *testing.T, kv events.KV, idx *indexv1alpha1.Indexer) *cardigann.Session {
	t.Helper()
	e, err := kv.Get(t.Context(), clients.SessionKey(idx.UID))
	if errors.Is(err, events.ErrKeyNotFound) {
		return nil
	}
	require.NoError(t, err)
	s, err := cardigann.UnmarshalSession(e.Value)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	return s
}

// interleavingKV runs between once, right after the first successful Get.
// That puts a real second writer inside Drop's read-then-delete window.
type interleavingKV struct {
	events.KV
	once    sync.Once
	between func()
}

func (k *interleavingKV) Get(ctx context.Context, key string) (events.Entry, error) {
	e, err := k.KV.Get(ctx, key)
	if err == nil {
		k.once.Do(k.between)
	}
	return e, err
}

// The KV half of the Drop CAS (§5.3.2 step 4). The manager logs in and saves
// in one process. A cached client's failed relogin drops in another. A drop
// may delete only the session that failed, never one saved since.
func TestSessionDropInKV(t *testing.T) {
	idx := &indexv1alpha1.Indexer{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "kv", Namespace: "media", UID: "uid-kv"}}
	s1, s2 := sessionOf("s1"), sessionOf("s2")

	t.Run("drops the session that failed", func(t *testing.T) {
		kv := sessionsKV(t)
		mgr := &clients.SessionStore{KV: kv, Manager: k8s.ManagerIndexarr}
		require.NoError(t, mgr.Save(t.Context(), idx, s1))
		agent := &clients.SessionStore{KV: kv, Manager: k8s.ManagerIndexarrWorker}
		require.NoError(t, agent.Drop(t.Context(), idx, s1))
		require.Nil(t, kvSession(t, kv, idx))
	})

	t.Run("keeps a newer session already there", func(t *testing.T) {
		kv := sessionsKV(t)
		mgr := &clients.SessionStore{KV: kv, Manager: k8s.ManagerIndexarr}
		require.NoError(t, mgr.Save(t.Context(), idx, s2))
		agent := &clients.SessionStore{KV: kv, Manager: k8s.ManagerIndexarrWorker}
		require.NoError(t, agent.Drop(t.Context(), idx, s1))
		require.Equal(t, "uid=s2", kvSession(t, kv, idx).CookieHeader(),
			"the agent's Drop deleted the session the manager saved after the failure")
	})

	t.Run("keeps a session saved between the read and the delete", func(t *testing.T) {
		kv := sessionsKV(t)
		mgr := &clients.SessionStore{KV: kv, Manager: k8s.ManagerIndexarr}
		require.NoError(t, mgr.Save(t.Context(), idx, s1))
		agent := &clients.SessionStore{Manager: k8s.ManagerIndexarrWorker, KV: &interleavingKV{KV: kv, between: func() {
			require.NoError(t, mgr.Save(t.Context(), idx, s2))
		}}}
		require.NoError(t, agent.Drop(t.Context(), idx, s1))
		require.Equal(t, "uid=s2", kvSession(t, kv, idx).CookieHeader(),
			"a value check followed by Delete removed the session saved inside the window: Drop must use DeleteRevision")
	})

	t.Run("a client that had no session drops nothing", func(t *testing.T) {
		kv := sessionsKV(t)
		mgr := &clients.SessionStore{KV: kv, Manager: k8s.ManagerIndexarr}
		require.NoError(t, mgr.Save(t.Context(), idx, s2))
		agent := &clients.SessionStore{KV: kv, Manager: k8s.ManagerIndexarrWorker}
		require.NoError(t, agent.Drop(t.Context(), idx, nil))
		require.Equal(t, "uid=s2", kvSession(t, kv, idx).CookieHeader())
	})
}
```

```go
package clients_test

import (
	"context"
	"sync"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	corev1 "k8s.io/api/core/v1"
	"sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"

	"github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/indexer/clients"
	"github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/cardigann"
	"github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/k8s"
)

// interleavingClient runs between once, right after the first successful
// Secret Get. A real second writer then lands between Drop's live read and
// its apply, which is the lost-update window CLAUDE.md describes.
type interleavingClient struct {
	client.Client
	once    sync.Once
	between func()
}

func (c *interleavingClient) Get(ctx context.Context, key client.ObjectKey, obj client.Object, opts ...client.GetOption) error {
	err := c.Client.Get(ctx, key, obj, opts...)
	if _, ok := obj.(*corev1.Secret); ok && err == nil {
		c.once.Do(c.between)
	}
	return err
}

// §5.15. Both cases start from a Secret the manager saved (S1) and assert
// metadata.managedFields by manager name.
func TestSessionDropDoesNotWipeANewerSave(t *testing.T) {
	c := sessionEnvtest(t)

	t.Run("interleaved: a Save between the agent's read and its Drop wins", func(t *testing.T) {
		ctx := t.Context()
		kv := sessionsKV(t)
		idx := sessionIndexer(t, c, "session-drop", "interleaved")
		mgr := clients.NewSessionStore(c, nil, k8s.ManagerIndexarr)
		mgr.KV = kv
		require.NoError(t, mgr.Save(ctx, idx, sessionOf("s1")))

		agent := clients.NewSessionStore(&interleavingClient{Client: c, between: func() {
			require.NoError(t, mgr.Save(ctx, idx, sessionOf("s2")))
		}}, nil, k8s.ManagerIndexarrWorker)
		agent.KV = kv
		require.NoError(t, agent.Drop(ctx, idx, sessionOf("s1")))

		sec := readSessionSecret(t, c, idx)
		got, err := cardigann.UnmarshalSession(sec.Data[clients.SessionSecretKeySession])
		require.NoError(t, err, "the agent's Drop emptied the Secret the manager had just saved")
		require.Equal(t, "uid=s2", got.CookieHeader())
		require.Equal(t, "uid=s2", kvSession(t, kv, idx).CookieHeader())
		require.True(t, ownsField(t, sec, k8s.ManagerIndexarr, "f:data", "f:session"))
		require.True(t, ownsField(t, sec, k8s.ManagerIndexarr, "f:data", "f:cookie"))
		for _, mf := range sec.ManagedFields {
			require.NotEqual(t, k8s.ManagerIndexarrWorker.String(), mf.Manager,
				"indexarr-worker applied to a Secret that held nothing of its to drop")
		}
	})

	t.Run("drop applies: the failed session is emptied and the next Save takes it back", func(t *testing.T) {
		ctx := t.Context()
		kv := sessionsKV(t)
		idx := sessionIndexer(t, c, "session-drop", "applies")
		mgr := clients.NewSessionStore(c, nil, k8s.ManagerIndexarr)
		mgr.KV = kv
		require.NoError(t, mgr.Save(ctx, idx, sessionOf("s1")))
		agent := clients.NewSessionStore(c, nil, k8s.ManagerIndexarrWorker)
		agent.KV = kv
		require.NoError(t, agent.Drop(ctx, idx, sessionOf("s1")))

		sec := readSessionSecret(t, c, idx)
		require.Empty(t, sec.Data[clients.SessionSecretKeySession])
		require.Empty(t, sec.Data[clients.SessionSecretKeyCookie])
		require.Nil(t, kvSession(t, kv, idx))
		loaded, err := agent.Load(ctx, idx)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Nil(t, loaded, "Load still returns the session the agent dropped")
		for _, path := range [][]string{{"f:data", "f:session"}, {"f:data", "f:cookie"}, {"f:metadata", "f:ownerReferences"}, {"f:type"}} {
			require.True(t, ownsField(t, sec, k8s.ManagerIndexarrWorker, path...),
				"indexarr-worker does not own %v after its Drop: the emptied declaration was not complete", path)
		}
		require.False(t, ownsField(t, sec, k8s.ManagerIndexarr, "f:data", "f:session"))

		require.NoError(t, mgr.Save(ctx, idx, sessionOf("s3")))
		sec = readSessionSecret(t, c, idx)
		require.True(t, ownsField(t, sec, k8s.ManagerIndexarr, "f:data", "f:session"))
		require.True(t, ownsField(t, sec, k8s.ManagerIndexarr, "f:data", "f:cookie"))
		require.False(t, ownsField(t, sec, k8s.ManagerIndexarrWorker, "f:data", "f:session"))
		require.Equal(t, "uid=s3", string(sec.Data[clients.SessionSecretKeyCookie]))
	})
}
```

```go
// The manager logged in again while a cached client in the agent still held
// the killed session. That client's relogin then failed. Its Drop must leave
// the manager's new session where it is, in the Secret and in KV. Before the
// compare-and-swap, an unconditional Drop wiped it, and every search used no
// session until the next reprobe (§5.3.2).
func TestAFailedReLoginKeepsASessionTheManagerSavedMeanwhile(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	c := newTestClient(t)
	ns := newNamespace(t, ctx, c, "idx-relogin-newer")
	createDefinition(t, c, "synthetic-form-relogin-newer", "login-form.yml")
	tracker := newExpiringTracker(t)
	name := loginIndexer(t, c, ns, "newer", "synthetic-form-relogin-newer", tracker.srv.URL, "wrong-now")
	idx := mustGet(t, c, name)

	bus := newMemBus(t)
	mgr := clients.NewSessionStore(c, bus, k8s.ManagerIndexarr)
	agent := clients.NewSessionStore(c, bus, k8s.ManagerIndexarrWorker)
	require.NoError(t, mgr.Save(ctx, &idx, &cardigann.Session{Cookies: []*http.Cookie{{Name: "uid", Value: "killed"}}}))

	cc := clientcache.NewClientCache(c, nil)
	cc.Sessions = agent
	cli, err := cc.For(ctx, &idx) // built with the killed session
	require.NoError(t, err)

	require.NoError(t, mgr.Save(ctx, &idx, &cardigann.Session{Cookies: []*http.Cookie{{Name: "uid", Value: "sess-manager"}}}))

	_, err = cli.Search(ctx, torznab.Query{Type: torznab.ModeSearch, Q: "movie"})
	var le *cardigann.LoginError
	require.True(t, errors.As(err, &le), "want the relogin's failure, got %v", err)

	kept, err := agent.Load(ctx, &idx)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, kept, "the failed relogin dropped the session the manager saved after it")
	require.Equal(t, "uid=sess-manager", kept.CookieHeader())
}
```

In `app/indexer/clients/session.go` (imports gain `bytes` and
`k8s.io/client-go/util/retry`), replace `Drop`:

```go
// Drop forgets idx's session, but only while the stored session is still
// failed: the one a cached client was using when the tracker killed it and
// its relogin failed. A session saved since then (the manager's login, in
// another process since the split) is left alone in the Secret and in KV
// (§5.3.2). A nil failed drops nothing: a client that had no session has
// nothing of its own to invalidate.
//
// The Secret is emptied rather than deleted, under s.Manager, with the same
// complete declaration Save makes, so this needs no verb Save lacks. The
// Secret goes first and KV second, the order Save writes them.
func (s *SessionStore) Drop(ctx context.Context, idx *indexv1alpha1.Indexer, failed *cardigann.Session) error {
	if s == nil || failed == nil {
		return nil
	}
	want, err := cardigann.MarshalSession(failed)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var errs []error
	if s.Client != nil {
		if err := s.dropSecret(ctx, idx, want); err != nil {
			errs = append(errs, err)
		}
	}
	if s.KV != nil {
		if err := s.dropKV(ctx, idx, want); err != nil {
			errs = append(errs, err)
		}
	}
	return errors.Join(errs...)
}

// dropSecret is §5.3.2 steps 1-3. It does a live read (Secrets are never
// cached), returns without writing unless data.session is still want, and
// otherwise applies the emptied declaration at the read's resourceVersion.
// A Conflict means someone wrote in between, so the whole step runs again
// from a fresh read.
func (s *SessionStore) dropSecret(ctx context.Context, idx *indexv1alpha1.Indexer, want []byte) error {
	key := types.NamespacedName{Namespace: idx.Namespace, Name: SessionSecretName(idx.Name)}
	err := retry.RetryOnConflict(retry.DefaultRetry, func() error {
		var sec corev1.Secret
		if err := s.Client.Get(ctx, key, &sec); err != nil {
			if apierrors.IsNotFound(err) {
				return nil
			}
			return err
		}
		if !ownedBy(sec.OwnerReferences, idx.UID) || !sameSession(sec.Data[SessionSecretKeySession], want) {
			return nil // a newer session, or not this Indexer's: nothing of ours to drop
		}
		ac := sessionSecretAC(idx, map[string][]byte{
			SessionSecretKeySession: {},
			SessionSecretKeyCookie:  {},
		}).WithResourceVersion(sec.ResourceVersion)
		_, err := k8s.Apply(ctx, s.Client, s.Manager, ac)
		return err
	})
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("indexer: empty session secret %s: %w", key, err)
	}
	return nil
}

// dropKV is §5.3.2 step 4. A revision mismatch means a newer session was put
// after the read, and that session stays.
func (s *SessionStore) dropKV(ctx context.Context, idx *indexv1alpha1.Indexer, want []byte) error {
	key := SessionKey(idx.UID)
	e, err := s.KV.Get(ctx, key)
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, events.ErrKeyNotFound):
		return nil
	case err != nil:
		return fmt.Errorf("indexer: read session from %s: %w", events.BucketIndexerSessions, err)
	}
	if !sameSession(e.Value, want) {
		return nil
	}
	if err := s.KV.DeleteRevision(ctx, key, e.Revision); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, events.ErrRevisionMismatch) {
		return fmt.Errorf("indexer: drop session from %s: %w", events.BucketIndexerSessions, err)
	}
	return nil
}

// sameSession reports whether raw holds the session that marshals to want.
// raw is decoded and re-encoded first, so two encodings of one session
// compare equal. Empty or undecodable bytes never match.
func sameSession(raw, want []byte) bool {
	got, err := cardigann.UnmarshalSession(raw)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	norm, err := cardigann.MarshalSession(got)
	return err == nil && bytes.Equal(norm, want)
}
```

In `app/indexer/clients/cardigann.go`:

```go
// ReloginFunc logs in again after the tracker killed stale, the session the
// client was using, and persists the new session. When the login fails, stale

type ReloginFunc func(ctx context.Context, stale *cardigann.Session) (*cardigann.Session, error)
```

The `CardigannClient` relogin hook (the field or setter X2 exported for
`clientcache.reloginFunc`; find it with
`grep -n 'relogin' app/indexer/clients/cardigann.go`) takes the type

In `app/indexer/clientcache/clientcache.go`, `reloginFunc` returns

```go
package clientcache_test

import (
	"context"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
	"k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/types"
	"k8s.io/utils/ptr"
	"sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"
	"sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client/fake"

	commonv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/common/v1alpha1"
	indexv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/index/v1alpha1"
	"github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/indexer/clientcache"
	"github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/indexer/clients"
	"github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/k8s"
	"github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/ratelimit"
)

func rlClient(t *testing.T, objs ...client.Object) client.Client {
	t.Helper()
	return fake.NewClientBuilder().WithScheme(k8s.MustNewScheme()).WithObjects(objs...).Build()
}

// rlIndexer is a generic Indexer named after its UID.
func rlIndexer(uid types.UID, generation int64, rv, baseURL string, delay *metav1.Duration) *indexv1alpha1.Indexer {
	return &indexv1alpha1.Indexer{
		ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{
			Name: string(uid), Namespace: "media", UID: uid, Generation: generation, ResourceVersion: rv,
		},
		Spec: indexv1alpha1.IndexerSpec{
			BaseURL:      baseURL,
			Generic:      &indexv1alpha1.GenericNewznab{Protocol: commonv1alpha1.ProtocolTorrent},
			RequestDelay: delay,
		},
	}
}

// rlPacedAbove asserts that key's bucket refills more slowly than d. It takes
// the bucket's burst token, then waits with a deadline d away.
// golang.org/x/time/rate refuses at once a wait it can already see will
// outlast its deadline, and pkg/ratelimit reports that as
// context.DeadlineExceeded. A bucket that refills inside d makes Wait block
// and succeed instead, so a regression fails within d. It never hangs.
func rlPacedAbove(t *testing.T, lim *ratelimit.Limiter, key string, d time.Duration) {
	t.Helper()
	require.True(t, lim.Allow(key), "%s: the bucket's first token was not there", key)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(t.Context(), d)
	defer cancel()
	start := time.Now()
	err := lim.Wait(ctx, key)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, context.DeadlineExceeded, "%s refilled within %s: the Indexer's requestDelay was not applied", key, d)
	require.Less(t, time.Since(start), d/2, "%s: the wait blocked instead of failing at once", key)
}

// In the index agent no Indexer reconciler runs, so the cache is what
// installs each host's spec.requestDelay (§5.12). Every case starts from a
// limiter whose default is unlimited, so any pacing seen was applied here,
// except the explicit-zero case, which starts from the CRD default and
// proves that an explicit 0s overrides it.
func TestClientCacheAppliesTheIndexersRequestDelay(t *testing.T) {
	leetx, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join("..", "..", "..", "test", "data", "cardigann", "1337x.yml"))
	require.NoError(t, err)

	t.Run("a 5s requestDelay is honoured", func(t *testing.T) {
		lim := ratelimit.New(ratelimit.Config{})
		cc := clientcache.NewClientCache(rlClient(t), lim)
		_, err := cc.For(t.Context(), rlIndexer("u-slow", 1, "1", "https://slow.invalid", &metav1.Duration{Duration: 5 * time.Second}))
		require.NoError(t, err)
		rlPacedAbove(t, lim, "slow.invalid", 4*time.Second)
	})

	t.Run("an explicit 0s requestDelay stays unpaced", func(t *testing.T) {
		lim := ratelimit.New(clients.DefaultLimiterConfig())
		cc := clientcache.NewClientCache(rlClient(t), lim)
		_, err := cc.For(t.Context(), rlIndexer("u-zero", 1, "1", "https://public.invalid", &metav1.Duration{}))
		require.NoError(t, err)
		for i := range 50 {
			require.True(t, lim.Allow("public.invalid"), "request %d was paced, but this indexer explicitly asked not to be", i)
		}
	})

	t.Run("a definition's requestDelay is the floor", func(t *testing.T) {
		lim := ratelimit.New(ratelimit.Config{})
		def := &indexv1alpha1.IndexerDefinition{
			ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "leetx-def"},
			Spec:       indexv1alpha1.IndexerDefinitionSpec{YAML: string(leetx)},
		}
		cc := clientcache.NewClientCache(rlClient(t, def), lim)
		idx := &indexv1alpha1.Indexer{
			ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "leetx", Namespace: "media", UID: "u-leetx", Generation: 1, ResourceVersion: "1"},
			Spec: indexv1alpha1.IndexerSpec{
				BaseURL: "https://1337x.to/", DefinitionRef: ptr.To("leetx-def"),
				RequestDelay: &metav1.Duration{Duration: time.Second},
			},
		}
		_, err := cc.For(t.Context(), idx)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		// 1337x.yml declares requestDelay: 3, which raises the spec's 1s.
		rlPacedAbove(t, lim, "1337x.to", 2500*time.Millisecond)
	})
}

// A search or poll that read the Indexer before an edit misses the
// resourceVersion lookup and rebuilds. It must neither put the old
// requestDelay back on the host nor replace the newer cached client (R8
// amendment).
func TestAStaleIndexerDoesNotRevertANewerRequestDelay(t *testing.T) {
	lim := ratelimit.New(ratelimit.Config{})
	cc := clientcache.NewClientCache(rlClient(t), lim)
	fresh := rlIndexer("u-edit", 2, "20", "https://edited.invalid", &metav1.Duration{Duration: 5 * time.Second})
	stale := rlIndexer("u-edit", 1, "10", "https://edited.invalid", &metav1.Duration{Duration: time.Second})

	first, err := cc.For(t.Context(), fresh)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, err = cc.For(t.Context(), stale)
	require.NoError(t, err, "a stale object still gets a client for its one call")
	require.False(t, cc.ApplyRateLimit(stale, nil, 0), "an older generation was applied over a newer one")

	again, err := cc.For(t.Context(), fresh)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Same(t, first, again, "the stale object's client replaced the newer generation's cached one")
	rlPacedAbove(t, lim, "edited.invalid", 4*time.Second)
}

// The newer generation applies whatever order the objects arrive in.
func TestANewerGenerationAppliesAfterAnOlderOne(t *testing.T) {
	lim := ratelimit.New(ratelimit.Config{})
	cc := clientcache.NewClientCache(rlClient(t), lim)
	_, err := cc.For(t.Context(), rlIndexer("u-up", 1, "10", "https://up.invalid", &metav1.Duration{Duration: time.Second}))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, err = cc.For(t.Context(), rlIndexer("u-up", 2, "20", "https://up.invalid", &metav1.Duration{Duration: 5 * time.Second}))
```

```go
import (

// The limiter's fallback paces a host no Indexer has configured yet at the
// CRD's own spec.requestDelay default, read from the generated schema. The
// manager and the index agent both build their limiter from it. A
// ratelimit.Config{} fallback is rate.Inf, which leaves every such host
// unpaced, and against a private tracker that is a ban.
func TestDefaultLimiterConfigPacesAtTheCRDDefault(t *testing.T) {
	raw, err := os.ReadFile("../../../config/crd/bases/index.clustarr.io_indexers.yaml")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	var crd struct {
		Spec struct {
			Versions []struct {
				Schema struct {
					OpenAPIV3Schema struct {
						Properties struct {
							Spec struct {
								Properties map[string]struct {
									Default string `json:"default"`
								} `json:"properties"`
							} `json:"spec"`
						} `json:"properties"`
					} `json:"openAPIV3Schema"`
				} `json:"schema"`
			} `json:"versions"`
		} `json:"spec"`
	}
	require.NoError(t, yaml.Unmarshal(raw, &crd))
	require.NotEmpty(t, crd.Spec.Versions, "the CRD was not parsed; run `make manifests`")
	def, err := time.ParseDuration(crd.Spec.Versions[0].Schema.OpenAPIV3Schema.Properties.Spec.Properties["requestDelay"].Default)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	cfg := clients.DefaultLimiterConfig()
	require.InDelta(t, 1/def.Seconds(), cfg.RPS, 1e-9)
	require.Equal(t, 1, cfg.Burst)

	lim := ratelimit.New(cfg)
	require.True(t, lim.Allow("tracker.invalid:8443"))
	require.False(t, lim.Allow("tracker.invalid:8443"), "an unconfigured host is unpaced")
}
```

```go
// DefaultLimiterConfig is the bucket a ratelimit.Limiter gives a host that
// has no Config of its own yet. It is the CRD's spec.requestDelay default,
// never the zero Config, whose RPS of 0 is rate.Inf. The manager's Indexer
// reconciler and the index agent's ClientCache each build their own limiter
// from it (§5.12). An explicit requestDelay: 0s is unaffected, because
// SetConfig installs a Config for that key and the key then never reads
// this default.
func DefaultLimiterConfig() ratelimit.Config {
	return ratelimit.Config{RPS: 1 / defaultRequestDelay.Seconds(), Burst: 1}
}
```

installs spec.requestDelay as this indexer HOST's bucket config. Two callers
write it, each into its own process's limiter: the Indexer reconciler in the
manager, and clientcache.ClientCache.ApplyRateLimit in the index agent, gated
on generation so a stale object cannot revert an edit. Nothing else writes
it." The paragraph about the fan-out not being a writer becomes: "The search

writes on their behalf, once per Indexer generation."

```go
type ClientCache struct {
	// ... existing fields ...

	mu      sync.Mutex
	entries map[types.UID]clientEntry
	// applied is the newest generation of each Indexer whose requestDelay
	// this cache has written to its limiter. It outlives an entry's Forget
	// (a session change) and is dropped only when Prune sees the Indexer
	// gone (W4.23), so an object read before an edit can never put the old
	// delay back.
	applied map[types.UID]int64
}

type clientEntry struct {
	resourceVersion string
	generation      int64
	proxies         string
	client          clients.Client
	builtAt         time.Time
}

func NewClientCache(c client.Client, limiters *ratelimit.Limiter) *ClientCache {
	return &ClientCache{
		client: c, limiters: limiters,
		entries: map[types.UID]clientEntry{}, applied: map[types.UID]int64{},
	}
}

// ApplyRateLimit writes idx's spec.requestDelay, raised to floor (a
// definition's own requestDelay), onto this cache's limiter. It skips the
// write when it has already applied a NEWER generation of the same Indexer,
// and reports whether it wrote. An equal generation applies again. A
// status-only change, a proxy change or a definition edit leaves generation
// alone, and re-applying the same spec is harmless.
func (cc *ClientCache) ApplyRateLimit(idx *indexv1alpha1.Indexer, def *cardigann.Definition, floor time.Duration) bool {
	if idx == nil || cc.limiters == nil {
		return false
	}
	cc.mu.Lock()
	defer cc.mu.Unlock()
	if cc.applied == nil {
		cc.applied = map[types.UID]int64{}
	}
	if last, ok := cc.applied[idx.UID]; ok && idx.Generation < last {
		return false
	}
	clients.ApplyRateLimit(idx.Spec, def, cc.limiters, floor)
	cc.applied[idx.UID] = idx.Generation
	return true
}
```

`store` records the generation and never lets an older object replace a
newer entry:

```go
func (cc *ClientCache) store(idx *indexv1alpha1.Indexer, proxies string, built clients.Client) {
	if cc.ttl() < 0 {
		return
	}
	cc.mu.Lock()
	defer cc.mu.Unlock()
	if cc.entries == nil {
		cc.entries = map[types.UID]clientEntry{}
	}
	if e, ok := cc.entries[idx.UID]; ok && idx.Generation < e.generation {
		return // a stale object's client never replaces a newer one's
	}
	cc.entries[idx.UID] = clientEntry{
		resourceVersion: idx.ResourceVersion, generation: idx.Generation,
		proxies: proxies, client: built, builtAt: cc.now(),
	}
}
```

```go
		_, err = cc.For(ctx, a)

		require.Eventually(t, func() bool { return cc.Len() == 0 }, 5*time.Second, 10*time.Millisecond,
			"a dropped session left the client that used it cached")
	})
```

```go
// sessionRewatchDelay is how long WatchSessions waits before watching the
// sessions bucket again after its watch ended (a NATS restart wipes a
// memory-backed bucket on single-node NATS, ending every watch on it).
const sessionRewatchDelay = 5 * time.Second

// Prune drops every entry older than the TTL, and the entry and applied
// generation of every Indexer that is no longer in cc's client (the agent's
// informer). It replaces the reconciler's delete-time Forget, which ran in
// the manager since the split and could not reach this cache. If the List
// fails it prunes by age only and keeps every applied generation, because
// dropping a live one would reopen the stale-revert window.
func (cc *ClientCache) Prune(ctx context.Context, now time.Time) {
	var live map[types.UID]bool
	var list indexv1alpha1.IndexerList
	if err := cc.client.List(ctx, &list); err != nil {
		logging.FromContext(ctx).Warn("clientcache: listing Indexers to prune failed; pruning by age only", "error", err)
	} else {
		live = make(map[types.UID]bool, len(list.Items))
		for i := range list.Items {
			live[list.Items[i].UID] = true
		}
	}
	ttl := cc.ttl()
	cc.mu.Lock()
	defer cc.mu.Unlock()
	for uid, e := range cc.entries {
		if (live != nil && !live[uid]) || (ttl > 0 && now.Sub(e.builtAt) >= ttl) {
			delete(cc.entries, uid)
		}
	}
	if live != nil {
		for uid := range cc.applied {
			if !live[uid] {
				delete(cc.applied, uid)
			}
		}
	}
}

// WatchSessions keeps the cache current across processes, and runs until ctx
// ends. Any Put or Delete of an Indexer's key in kv (the
// clustarr-indexer-sessions bucket) evicts that Indexer's client, so the next
// For rebuilds with the session the manager saved or the agent dropped.
// Every TTL it also Prunes. The index agent adds it as a k8s.EveryReplica
// (§5.12). A watch that ends while ctx is live is re-established after
// sessionRewatchDelay. Until then the TTL bounds how long a cached client
// can carry a replaced session.
func (cc *ClientCache) WatchSessions(ctx context.Context, kv events.KV) error {
	log := logging.FromContext(ctx)
	every := cc.ttl()
	if every <= 0 {
		every = DefaultClientCacheTTL
	}
	prune := time.NewTicker(every)
	defer prune.Stop()
	rewatch := time.NewTimer(0)
	defer rewatch.Stop()
	var updates <-chan events.Entry
	for {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return nil
		case <-rewatch.C:
			ch, err := kv.Watch(ctx, ">")
			if err != nil {
				log.Warn("clientcache: watching the sessions bucket failed; retrying", "error", err)
				rewatch.Reset(sessionRewatchDelay)
				continue
			}
			updates = ch
		case e, ok := <-updates:
			if !ok {
				updates = nil
				if ctx.Err() != nil {
					return nil
				}
				log.Warn("clientcache: the sessions watch ended; watching again")
				rewatch.Reset(sessionRewatchDelay)
				continue
			}
			cc.forgetSession(e.Key)
		case <-prune.C:
			cc.Prune(ctx, cc.now())
		}
	}
}

// forgetSession evicts the client of the Indexer whose session key is key.
// It leaves the applied generation alone.
func (cc *ClientCache) forgetSession(key string) {
	cc.mu.Lock()
	defer cc.mu.Unlock()
	for uid := range cc.entries {
		if clients.SessionKey(uid) == key {
			delete(cc.entries, uid)
		}
	}
}
```

The doc of `Forget` gains: "It evicts the client only. The applied generation
stays until Prune sees the Indexer gone." The doc of `For` replaces "so the
reconciler calls [ClientCache.Forget] after every successful login" with "so
[ClientCache.WatchSessions] evicts the entry whenever the Indexer's session
key changes".

```go
// that Indexer. A key for an Indexer that is gone, or a ring key, maps to
// nothing.
func TestIndexersForSession(t *testing.T) {
	a := &indexv1alpha1.Indexer{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Namespace: "media", Name: "a", UID: "uid-a"}}
	b := &indexv1alpha1.Indexer{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Namespace: "media", Name: "b", UID: "uid-b"}}
	r := &Reconciler{Client: fake.NewClientBuilder().WithScheme(k8s.MustNewScheme()).WithObjects(a, b).Build()}

	want := []reconcile.Request{{NamespacedName: types.NamespacedName{Namespace: "media", Name: "b"}}}
	require.Equal(t, want, r.indexersForSession(t.Context(), clients.SessionKey("uid-b")))
	require.Empty(t, r.indexersForSession(t.Context(), clients.SessionKey("uid-gone")))
	require.Empty(t, r.indexersForSession(t.Context(), limits.QueryKey("uid-b")), "a ring key is not a session key")
}

// Only a Delete enqueues. A Put is the manager's own Save or an agent's
// successful relogin, and neither needs a login. The watch delivers in order,
// so if a Put had enqueued, its Indexer would be first in the queue, ahead of
// the dropped one.
func TestSessionsSourceEnqueuesOnlyADroppedSession(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := t.Context()
	a := &indexv1alpha1.Indexer{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Namespace: "media", Name: "a", UID: "uid-a"}}
	b := &indexv1alpha1.Indexer{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Namespace: "media", Name: "b", UID: "uid-b"}}
	bus := membus.New(nil)
	require.NoError(t, bus.Ensure(ctx, events.Default().ForSingleNode()))
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = bus.Close() })
	r := &Reconciler{Client: fake.NewClientBuilder().WithScheme(k8s.MustNewScheme()).WithObjects(a, b).Build(), Bus: bus}

	q := workqueue.NewTypedRateLimitingQueue(workqueue.DefaultTypedControllerRateLimiter[reconcile.Request]())
	t.Cleanup(q.ShutDown)
	require.NoError(t, r.sessionsSource().Start(ctx, q))

	kv := bus.KV(events.BucketIndexerSessions)
	_, err := kv.Put(ctx, clients.SessionKey("uid-a"), []byte("saved"))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, err = kv.Put(ctx, clients.SessionKey("uid-b"), []byte("saved"))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, kv.Delete(ctx, clients.SessionKey("uid-b")))

	require.Eventually(t, func() bool { return q.Len() > 0 }, 5*time.Second, 10*time.Millisecond,
		"a dropped session never enqueued its Indexer")
	item, _ := q.Get()
	require.Equal(t, reconcile.Request{NamespacedName: types.NamespacedName{Namespace: "media", Name: "b"}}, item)
	q.Done(item)
	require.Zero(t, q.Len(), "a Put enqueued an Indexer: only a dropped session needs a login")
}
```

```go
// startIndexerControllerOn runs the Indexer controller through its own
// SetupWithManager, so its raw sources are what the test exercises, on a bus
// the test also holds.
func startIndexerControllerOn(t *testing.T, bus events.Bus) {
	t.Helper()
	mgr, err := ctrl.NewManager(testCfg, ctrl.Options{
		Scheme:                 k8s.MustNewScheme(),
		Metrics:                metricsserver.Options{BindAddress: k8s.DisabledBindAddress},
		HealthProbeBindAddress: k8s.DisabledBindAddress,
		Controller:             config.Controller{SkipNameValidation: ptr.To(true)},
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	r := indexer.NewReconciler(mgr.GetClient(), mgr.GetEventRecorder("indexer"), ratelimit.New(ratelimit.Config{}), bus)
	require.NoError(t, r.SetupWithManager(mgr))
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { done <- mgr.Start(ctx) }()
	t.Cleanup(func() { cancel(); require.NoError(t, <-done) })
}

// An agent's Drop reaches the manager at once. The reconciler watches the
// sessions bucket and logs in when a key is deleted, rather than at the next
// 15-minute reprobe (§5.12). Nothing else wakes this Indexer inside 30
// seconds (status writes are generation-filtered and no ring moves), so
// without sessionsSource the second login never comes.
func TestADroppedSessionLogsInAgainAtOnce(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	c := newTestClient(t)
	ns := newNamespace(t, ctx, c, "idx-session-dropped")
	createDefinition(t, c, "synthetic-form-login-dropped", "login-form.yml")
	tracker := newLoginTracker(t)
	name := loginIndexer(t, c, ns, "dropped", "synthetic-form-login-dropped", tracker.srv.URL, "hunter22")
	bus := newMemBus(t)
	startIndexerControllerOn(t, bus)

	require.Eventually(t, func() bool { return tracker.submits.Load() == 1 }, 30*time.Second, 100*time.Millisecond,
		"the reconciler never logged in")
	idx := mustGet(t, c, name)
	agent := clients.NewSessionStore(c, bus, k8s.ManagerIndexarrWorker)
	var current *cardigann.Session
	require.Eventually(t, func() bool {
		s, err := agent.Load(ctx, &idx)
		current = s
		return err == nil && s != nil
	}, 30*time.Second, 100*time.Millisecond, "the login's session was never persisted")

	// What a cached client's failed relogin does in the index agent.
	require.NoError(t, agent.Drop(ctx, &idx, current))

	require.Eventually(t, func() bool { return tracker.submits.Load() == 2 }, 30*time.Second, 100*time.Millisecond,
		"the manager did not log in after the agent dropped the session: it does not watch %s for deletes",
		events.BucketIndexerSessions)
}
```
